Previously, you had to manage two things: how many… The post GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Enterprises working with a GitHub or Microsoft account team can now get Copilot included with GitHub Enterprise for every licensed user. Previously, you had to manage two things: how many Copilot seats you were paying for and how much AI usage those users consumed.
takeaways: Copilot access through GitHub Enterprise and Copilot Standalone has the same features and models as Copilot Enterprise but does not include monthly AI credits per seat.
Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise remain available.
Users in your enterprise account who do not hold a GitHub Enterprise license get the same Copilot access through Copilot Standalone, at $10 per user per month.
